reports.title: Här är det senaste vi vet om drönaren i Pellinge
reports.assessment: The Border Guard investigation into the drone recovered at Pellinge near Porvoo remained at an early stage. Its origin and purpose were still being examined.

reports.title: Border Guard: Surveying drone found along Finnish coast is Russian-made
reports.assessment: The Border Guard identified the Porvoo/Pellinge device as a Russian-made Geoscan 701. Its operator was not confirmed. Authorities continued investigating; the President said there was no immediate threat.
